1840company-1840-company:lever:c6892c63-.description: We are currently seeking remote International Purchasing Coordinator in Colombia. To ensure success as an international purchasing coordinator, must have excellent customer service skills and the ability to interact effectively with a variety of staff members in all departments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:9e55b5c8-1f68-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Revenue Operations Data Analyst based in Canada. This role sits at the intersection of data quality, business intelligence, and revenue operations, helping ensure GTM teams have accurate information they can confidently act on. You’ll own the integrity and governance of data across Salesforce and related systems while building scalable reporting and analytics solutions. Your work will support Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and executive stakeholders with clear insights into pipeline, forecasting, conversion, productivity, and customer performance. You’ll replace manual processes with reliable dashboards, reusable data models, and automated workflows. The environment is fast-paced, collaborative, and highly data-driven, with significant ownership and opportunities to improve systems and processes. Over time, you’ll expand into a strategic analytics partner for Customer Success and broader revenue operations. Own the accuracy, cleanliness, and integrity of GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems, identifying data quality issues, closing gaps, and preventing recurring problems. Define and maintain data hygiene standards, field definitions, governance processes, and documentation to establish a trusted source of truth across the organization. Build and maintain reusable data models, datasets, and pipelines that enable consistent and scalable reporting. Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence tools for Sales and executive stakeholders. Analyze pipeline performance, forecasting, conversion rates, win/loss trends, productivity, and other revenue metrics to identify opportunities and recommend actions. Automate recurring reporting processes and replace manual spreadsheet-based workflows with scalable, governed BI solutions. Document KPI definitions, data logic, reporting methodologies, and processes while helping business users adopt self-service analytics practices. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into reliable, actionable analytics solutions. Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in data and reporting workflows and recommend improvements to data architecture, tools, processes, and governance. Support Customer Success analytics over time, including reporting, customer health scores, renewal analysis, churn, retention, and ad-hoc business analysis. Train stakeholders on dashboards, data definitions, and best practices for interpreting and using analytics. Use AI-assisted tools responsibly to improve efficiency, quality, analysis, and decision-making while maintaining professional oversight of outputs. Requirements: 3–5 years of experience in data, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, or a related function, ideally supporting Sales, GTM, or Revenue Operations. Demonstrated experience owning data quality, validation, hygiene, or governance processes as a core responsibility. Hands-on experience building production dashboards using Power BI and/or Tableau. Strong proficiency with DAX and Power Query (M), including data modeling, calculations, and transformation workflows. Solid understanding of data modeling concepts such as star and snowflake schemas, fact and dimension tables, and semantic layers. Familiarity with Salesforce data structures, reporting capabilities, and data governance practices. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, advanced formulas, and Power Query. Strong data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, decision-ready insights. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and translate their needs into scalable analytics and reporting solutions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a41ac33a-8840-.title: Channel Sales Manager - Microsoft Azure Data
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a41ac33a-8840-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Channel Sales Manager - Microsoft Azure Data based in the United States. This role is focused on building qualified pipeline through strategic channel execution and close collaboration with Microsoft Azure teams. You will convert partner referrals into qualified customer opportunities through structured discovery, qualification, and consistent follow-up. The position combines channel sales, customer engagement, pipeline management, event execution, and co-sell coordination. You will work directly with Microsoft account executives, technical specialists, partner managers, customers, and internal teams to advance opportunities. Success is highly execution-oriented, with qualified sales opportunities serving as a primary performance measure. The role offers significant autonomy, requiring strong organization, CRM discipline, proactive problem solving, and the ability to manage multiple priorities. You will also have the opportunity to influence revenue growth and go-to-market success while working within a fast-paced cloud and data technology environment. Pipeline conversion: Convert partner referrals and early-stage opportunities into sales-qualified opportunities through structured customer engagement, discovery calls, qualification, and business case development. Customer discovery: Lead discovery conversations to understand customer business challenges, assess solution fit, establish qualification criteria, and define clear next steps. Microsoft co-sell execution: Execute joint go-to-market motions with Microsoft Azure account teams, coordinating customer meetings, technical reviews, proof-of-concept discussions, and opportunity progression. Partner relationship management: Maintain active relationships with Microsoft account executives, technical specialists, partner managers, and other relevant stakeholders to drive consistent engagement and pipeline creation. Pipeline performance: Generate sales-qualified opportunities on a quarterly basis and maintain disciplined follow-up throughout the early opportunity lifecycle. CRM management: Maintain accurate and transparent Salesforce records, documenting customer interactions, qualification decisions, partner engagement, opportunity status, and next actions. Event execution: Develop event strategies before execution, including target-account identification, pre-event outreach, ownership plans, and post-event conversion timelines. Post-event follow-up: Execute structured follow-up after partner events with clear action plans, milestones, owners, and conversion objectives. Program management: Manage partner-program logistics and communications independently, ensuring timely delivery, effective execution, and strong partner experiences. Reporting: Provide weekly visibility into discovery activity, pipeline progression, blocked opportunities, planned unblock actions, and partner feedback. Issue resolution: Proactively identify blockers, escalate issues when appropriate, and take ownership of actions required to move opportunities forward. Cross-functional execution: Coordinate effectively across customers, partner organizations, sales teams, and internal stakeholders while managing multiple programs and priorities with limited oversight. Requirements: Experience: 3–5 years of experience in partner-facing, channel sales, field execution, or a similar role, preferably within cloud, data, or enterprise technology environments. Microsoft Azure: Direct experience working with Microsoft Azure in a co-sell, channel, partner, or field-engagement capacity. Pipeline development: Demonstrated ability to convert partner referrals into qualified customer opportunities and consistently progress early-stage pipeline. Cloud and data knowledge: Familiarity with cloud ecosystems and a foundational understanding of modern data platforms, analytics, and related technologies.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b59ffa0a-281b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Finance & Business Performance based in Germany. This is a senior finance leadership role focused on rebuilding and transforming the finance function of a growing multi-location food-service business. You will take ownership of core financial operations while strengthening cash management, payroll, reporting, controls, and compliance. Beyond traditional finance responsibilities, you will turn financial data into practical insights that guide business decisions and improve performance. You will lead budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis, and investment evaluation across locations, brands, channels, and products. The role requires a commercially minded finance leader who can connect financial performance with pricing, operations, and growth decisions. You will also redesign finance structures, systems, and controls to create a more scalable and reliable function. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced finance executive who enjoys building from the ground up and creating lasting organizational impact. Lead the finance function through a hands-on transformation, establishing strong processes, controls, reporting standards, and operating rhythms. Take ownership of core financial operations, ensuring cash, payroll, compliance, and other critical financial responsibilities are properly controlled. Build accurate, timely, and actionable financial reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into business performance. Own annual budgets, rolling forecasts, cash planning, and financial projections, continuously updating assumptions based on business performance. Develop profitability reporting by location, brand, channel, and product to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Analyze unit economics and financial drivers to help leadership understand the factors influencing profitability and sustainable growth. Evaluate pricing, promotions, investments, and strategic initiatives through robust financial models and business cases. Partner with operational and commercial leaders to translate financial insights into practical actions and measurable business improvements. Redesign finance team structures, systems, workflows, and internal controls to improve efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and accountability. Introduce modern finance technologies, AI tools, and automation to streamline reporting, analysis, forecasting, and decision-making. Establish clear financial performance metrics and ensure leadership has timely visibility into risks, opportunities, and key business trends. Develop finance talent and build a sustainable succession plan, including the eventual development of a successor capable of taking ownership of the function. Provide evidence-based financial guidance to senior executives and constructively challenge decisions when financial analysis indicates a different course of action. Requirements Significant senior-level finance leadership experience, ideally with experience operating at CFO, Finance Director, or equivalent level. Demonstrated success improving profitability, financial forecasting, cash management, reporting, and overall finance operations. Strong commercial understanding, including pricing strategy, unit economics, investment analysis, profitability drivers, and business-case development. Advanced, hands-on experience with AI, automation, modern finance technologies, and data-driven financial analysis. Strong accounting and financial management knowledge, with a professional finance or accounting qualification strongly preferred. Experience building or transforming finance functions, particularly in environments where processes and systems require significant improvement. southparkcommons-material-security:ashby.description: Material Security is looking for a Channel Sales Manager to build and scale our VAR and reseller partner ecosystem. You'll recruit new partners, deepen relationships with existing ones, and turn those relationships into net-new pipeline and faster-closing deals for our direct sales team. This is a build-from-the-ground-up role for someone who has done it before and wants ownership over a channel motion from day one. RESPONSIBILITIES - Recruit, onboard, and activate new VAR and channel reseller partners - Deepen the relationship and bi-directional deal flow with existing partners - Build and run a partner enablement program: training, deal registration, co-sell playbooks - Generate net-new partner-sourced pipeline in partnership with recruited VARs/resellers - Partner with the direct sales team to accelerate deal cycles on partner-influenced opportunities - Own partner relationship health, QBRs, and joint business planning with top partners - Track and report on partner-sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3-5+ years of experience working directly with VARs and channel resellers, building relationships that drove net-new pipeline - A track record of accelerating sales cycles through channel partnerships, not just adding volume - Experience designing partner enablement programs that partners actually use - Comfort operating with ambiguity and building a channel motion largely from scratch - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with direct sales, sales engineering, and marketing – Material Security is a remote-first workplace with an office in San Francisco, California. Compensation at Material Security is determined by a range of factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $200-230,000 OTE.
